kinds, emit_binop_for reads the floored left-operand type, vec_push
reads the floored call-result handle, and there is no registry. §7 now

for a fresh context, and marks scc-ordered-walk refuted. m3 assembly

mentl/866316b:
The §7 ev-slot seam was ORDER-UNSTABLE for captured/anonymous lambdas: PLACE
(derive_ev_slots' None branch) lays the closure ev region against the lambda's
OWN row (effects_of(lookup_ty(lambda)) — the deliberate Carried-Truth side), but
READ (lower_compute_ev_index_for_effect) indexed escaping_row(ls_outer_fn_name())
= the ENCLOSING fn, because ls_outer_fn_name skips the lambda's empty-name frame.
The lambda read its evidence at the enclosing's slot index, which SHIFTS as the
enclosing's escaping_row grows -> stale/OOB (emit_functions' (s)=>wat_emit(s):
place@8, read@12; this is the §7 "fragile to ANY row delta" exposed by the
reverted LFnRef Part-A growth, and present at clean HEAD).

Fix (pure LOWER, infer UNTOUCHED): align the in-lambda READ onto the SAME
projection PLACE uses. The frame carries the lambda's handle (lambda_h);
ls_current_lambda_handle() returns the innermost closure-owning lambda handle;
lower_compute_ev_index_for_effect reads effects_of(lookup_ty(lambda_h)) inside a
lambda, else escaping_row(ls_outer_fn_name()) verbatim. place==read by
construction (identical effects_of(lookup_ty) on the identical handle);
order-stable (the lambda's own-row index is invariant to enclosing growth);
ZERO bloat (record size unchanged — only the READ offset re-targets). Both layers
(seed mirrors via a $lower_current_lambda_h_g global + save/restore).

The stored inflight promise had no .catch() handler, so when analysis
rejected (e.g. non-mint account on devnet), the rejection propagated

bits/86caead:
The deck and its vocabulary go entirely: Deck and Library UI, the
pointer grammar, the program compiler with CUT/SPEED/SKIP/ZOOM, the
clip render path, the clips store, share-target plumbing, and the deck
e2e leg. Removal, not demotion: the playtest said speed-holds are
plumbing, and plumbing kept as a second screen is clutter with a
maintenance bill.

In its place, the instrument grows its organs. The recipe speaks show
natively: CAST (home rotation, a back flag for backdrops), PASS, SNIP,
MOUTH, DROP. Scissors split a puppet along a drawn line by half-plane
clipping; the far side hinges at the line's midpoint and dangles on a
damped angular spring driven by the root's acceleration, clamped and
bit-deterministic on the same fixed-step grid as the body. Mouths flap
with an RMS loudness envelope normalized to the track's own loud parts
(fast attack, slow release, gated shut under murmurs) and ride
whichever piece contains them, so a snipped-off head keeps its mouth.
The stage gains backdrops, two-finger resize/rotate staging, long-press
drop, re-cast-brings-to-front z-order, and beat ticks from the onset
grid. The e2e fixture now renders a snipped, mouthed, rotated cast and
re-probes the result; 24 unit tests cover the geometry, the envelope,
the dangles, and the replay contract.
